// Generated by the Refract plugin. Edit via the plugin or the properties panel.
import * as React from "react"
import { addPropertyControls, ControlType } from "framer"

const THICK: Record<string, number> = { low: 0.6, medium: 1, high: 1.5 }

/**
 * @framerSupportedLayoutWidth any
 * @framerSupportedLayoutHeight any
 */
export default function RefractGlass(props: any) {
  const { blur, refraction, dispersion, thickness, tint, radius, performance, style } = props
  const uid = React.useId().replace(/:/g, "")
  const [chromium, setChromium] = React.useState(false)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent
    setChromium(/Chrome|Chromium|Edg\//.test(ua) && !/Firefox/.test(ua))
  }, [])

  const t = THICK[thickness] ?? 1
  const scale = (refraction / 100) * 90 * t
  const useSvg = chromium && !performance && refraction > 0
  const bf = (useSvg ? "url(#" + uid + ") " : "") + "blur(" + blur + "px) saturate(1.35)"
  const fringe = (dispersion / 100) * 3 * t
  const a = 0.15 + (dispersion / 100) * 0.45

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        ...style,
        position: "relative",
        width: "100%",
        height: "100%",
        borderRadius: radius,
        overflow: "hidden",
        backdropFilter: bf,
        WebkitBackdropFilter: bf,
        background: "rgba(190,150,255," + (tint / 100) * 0.32 + ")",
        border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35)",
        boxShadow:
          "inset " + fringe + "px 0 0 rgba(255,60,140," + a + "), inset -" + fringe + "px 0 0 rgba(40,220,255," + a +
          "), inset 0 " + t * 2 + "px " + t * 6 + "px rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)",
      }}
    >
      {useSvg && (
        <svg width="0" height="0" style={{ position: "absolute" }}>
          <filter id={uid} x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%" colorInterpolationFilters="sRGB">
            <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.01" numOctaves={2} seed={3} result="n" />
            <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="n" scale={scale} xChannelSelector="R" yChannelSelector="G" />
          </filter>
        </svg>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

RefractGlass.defaultProps = { blur: 18, refraction: 64, dispersion: 38, thickness: "medium", tint: 0, radius: 24, performance: false }

addPropertyControls(RefractGlass, {
  blur: { type: ControlType.Number, title: "Blur", min: 0, max: 40, step: 1 },
  refraction: { type: ControlType.Number, title: "Refraction", min: 0, max: 100, unit: "%" },
  dispersion: { type: ControlType.Number, title: "Dispersion", min: 0, max: 100, unit: "%" },
  thickness: { type: ControlType.Enum, title: "Thickness", options: ["low", "medium", "high"], optionTitles: ["Low", "Medium", "High"] },
  tint: { type: ControlType.Number, title: "Tint", min: 0, max: 100, unit: "%" },
  radius: { type: ControlType.Number, title: "Radius", min: 0, max: 200 },
  performance: { type: ControlType.Boolean, title: "Performance" },
})
